title: Copilot cloud agent setup steps: keep .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml as a flat list of run/uses steps, no parallel: groups
answers: Copilot cloud agent sessions fail with 'Failed to launch agent' in about 2 seconds and produce no session logs after a workflow change
Why does the copilot-setup-steps workflow break when I add a parallel: block to speed up setup?
Where are the Copilot cloud agent environment setup steps defined in this repo?
How do I add a cache restore or setup action to the Copilot agent's pre-session steps?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, the job that Copilot cloud agent sessions read from the default branch to prepare their environment (setup-node, setup-python, setup-java, cache restores, pre-commit and install-bin caches, lint dependency install).
Rule: The Copilot launcher splices these steps into its own job, so every entry must be a plain `run` or `uses` step. Do not use a `parallel:` group (or any other non-run/uses construct); flatten parallel work into sequential steps. Cache restores and `pin-micro-version: false` on setup-python can stay as ordinary step `with:` inputs.
Symptom: Cloud agent sessions failed in about 2s with 'Failed to launch agent', with no session logs and no 'Running Copilot cloud agent' run. Introduced when a `parallel:` group was added to this file.
Constraints: Applies to edits of copilot-setup-steps.yml. Ordinary CI runs this file as a normal workflow and stays green even when the launcher would reject it, so a green CI does not prove sessions will launch.
applies: Edits to the Copilot cloud agent setup workflow file; does not cover other GitHub Actions workflows.
says: The cloud coding agent fails immediately on launch with no session logs.
Why do agent sessions crash instantly with a failed to launch message?
Add cache restoration and environment setup steps before the cloud agent starts.
Cloud agent sessions fail to start after changing the environment preparation steps.
Investigate why the automated assistant crashes within seconds before running any tasks.
search: Copilot cloud agent environment preparation in .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml must remain a flat sequential list of run or uses steps without parallel: groups because the launcher splices them directly into its job. Prepares the environment using setup-node, setup-python (supporting pin-micro-version: false), setup-java, cache restores, and lint dependency installation. Applies strictly to copilot-setup-steps.yml, where using parallel blocks causes agent launches to fail within seconds with 'Failed to launch agent', while standard CI remains green and masks the failure.
